# Vendored dependencies

- pangu 10.4.1: https://github.com/vinta/pangu.js (MIT).
- Noto Sans SC, @fontsource/noto-sans-sc 5.3.1: https://github.com/notofonts/noto-cjk (SIL OFL 1.1). Simplified Chinese WOFF2, weights 400 and 600.

Regenerate with `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm vendor`. License files accompany both distributions.
